From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation sprint blueprint & MAP template

Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I attached a lightweight MAP template and a proposed two-week evaluation sprint timeline that aligns with the scope we discussed (data access, privacy review, and a model-inference pilot). The template is intentionally opinionated so your stakeholders can see clear milestones and RACI ownership.

Key asks in advance of the kickoff workshop:
- Can you confirm the two stakeholders who will attend (technical + security/compliance)?
- Are there any compliance artifacts (DPA/SOC2) we should add to the MAP as pre-reqs?

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick review of the MAP template (attached) — you can comment directly in the Doc.
2) 45-minute kickoff workshop to align timelines and ownership (I suggested two slots in the calendar).
3) Shared success criteria and a short pilot scope to sign off before we start any dedicated infra.

Attachments: BlueCurrent_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc, Evaluation_Sprint_Timeline.xlsx

If this looks good I’ll have Lauren (Customer Success) adapt the MAP to include a compliance row and we’ll lock a workshop time.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the quick review. I pulled your feedback into a second-pass MAP (link below) and added a compliance row with proposed artifacts and owner columns. I also added a measurable pilot acceptance criteria section so the procurement folks can see latency/cost targets.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/bluecurrent-map-v2

Changes at a glance:
- Compliance row (DPA, SOC 2 evidence, encryption in transit at minimum)
- Pilot acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512-token inference; cost target <$0.015/request for the evaluation workload
- Milestones: Kickoff, Data access & allowlisting, Trial runs (internal), Pilot run (customer-facing), Sign-off

I’ve attached an updated MAP (BlueCurrent_MAP_Template_v2.gdoc) and a short kickoff agenda PDF. If that aligns, Karthik — please pick the best workshop slot and I’ll schedule a 45-min working session and invite the CSM and eng leads.

Regards,
